newsitem.title: USA: JPM Capital Trust I sets $750 mln in debt.
newsitem.headline: JPM Capital Trust I sets $750 mln in debt.

text.p: JPM Capital Trust I issued $750 million in capital securities due July 15, 2027 said lead underwriter JP Morgan Securities Inc on Tuesday.
The 7.54 percent Aa2/AA-minus rated capital securities were priced at par to yield a spread of 104 basis points over U.S. Treasuries, the underwriter said.
The size of the deal was initially expected to be about $600 million but was increased to $750 million to meet investor demand, sources said.
The JP Morgan deal adds to the evergrowing number of new bank preferred securities' offerings, now totaling close to $7.0 billion since last Tuesday, dealers said.
Also on Tuesday, the National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) recommended that insurance companies treat trust preferred stock as debt.
As part of its recommendation, the NAIC developed a criteria that would allow insurance companies to classify investment in trust preferred stock as debt, for risk-based capital purposes.
